verdict.rationale: Dagster documents official CLIs. The `dg` CLI has a dedicated configuration reference and supports `dg scaffold defs` for scaffolding component definitions and `dg dev` for running the local webserver, and `create-dagster` (e.g. `uvx create-dagster@latest project`) is the recommended way to scaffold new projects. Missing for 10: evidence that the CLI is designed for agent or automation use (e.g. machine-readable output or non-interactive modes), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI experience.
